name: CM32_machines_are_cards
origins: user requirement 2026-10-21 (run the games through the card model only)
statement: A CPU is its instruction cards and a machine is its hardware cards: every instruction card's semantics compile to the card IR and run identically in the reference interpreter and every embedded engine; its cycle-level timing (cycles, mcycles) and flag effects are data the bench checks against what the semantics do; a planted wrong instruction is caught; the machine module is all the emulator there is.
